title: International Higher National Diploma in Construction Technology (Level 5)
description: Develop practical and technical expertise in construction technology, site management, structural works, construction planning, and quality control for successful construction project delivery.
longDescription: The International Higher National Diploma in Construction Technology (Level 5) develops the technical knowledge and practical skills required to supervise and coordinate construction activities. Learners explore construction materials, site organisation, setting out, substructures, superstructures, and retaining walls. The programme covers the planning and supervision of roads, bridges, water supply, drainage, sewerage, and irrigation works. Learners develop competencies in preparing bills of quantities, estimating costs, managing workplace information, and coordinating construction teams. Upon completion, learners will be equipped to contribute effectively to construction project supervision, site operations, and the management of construction activities. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.

entry: For entry into Level 5 International Higher National Diploma in construction techonology, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from our partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: Plan Work To Be Performed In The Workplace
Conduct Field Investigations, Surveys And Tests Required For Feasibility Studies For Construction Work
Monitor Usage, Storage And Transportation Of Construction Materials
Supervise Construction Of Substructures And Retaining Walls
Supervise Construction Activities Of Superstructure Of Buildings
Supervise Construction Activities Of Roads/highways And Bridges
Supervise Construction Activities Of Water Supply, Drainage And Sewerage
Supervise Construction Activities Of Irrigation Work
Prepare Bill Of Quantities, Develop Budgets And Estimates

outcomes: Conduct construction site investigations by carrying out field surveys, feasibility assessments, and tests to support construction planning and decision-making.
Manage construction materials and site operations by overseeing the storage, handling, transportation, and efficient use of materials and organising construction sites.
Set out construction works using appropriate surveying techniques and procedures to establish accurate positions, dimensions, and levels for structures.
Supervise structural construction activities, including substructures, retaining walls, building superstructures, and finishing works, in accordance with project specifications.
Plan and supervise infrastructure projects, including roads, highways, bridges, water supply systems, drainage, sewerage, and irrigation works.
Prepare construction estimates and budgets by developing bills of quantities, calculating costs, and supporting the financial planning and control of construction projects.
Manage workplace information, communication, and work planning to coordinate construction teams, maintain accurate records, and support effective project delivery.
